title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.38133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. However, its expressivity does not, in general, come with formal guarantees that the generated objects satisfy hard constraints or requirements. In multi-agent generation, this problem becomes more challenging because a hard requirement can depend on multiple agents, while each agent may need to determine its own guidance input without relying on the simultaneously computed guidance inputs of other agents. To this end, we introduce DeGG-Flow, a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance. By representing the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, we develop guidance conditions for two classes of coupled requirements: shared requirements whose satisfaction depends on multiple agents together, and private requirements associated with each individual agent dependent on its neighbor

translated_title: 基于解耦生成引导的多智能体流匹配
translated_abstract: 生成建模被广泛用于从复杂的多模态分布中生成多样化的对象。然而，其表达能力通常并不附带形式化的保证，即所生成的对象能够满足硬性约束或要求。在多智能体生成中，这一问题变得更具挑战性，因为一个硬性要求可能依赖于多个智能体，而每个智能体可能需要在无法依赖其他智能体同时计算出的引导输入的情况下，独立确定自己的引导输入。为此，我们提出了DeGG-Flow，一个具有解耦生成引导的多智能体流匹配通用框架。通过将生成过程表示为一个控制仿射动力系统，我们为两类耦合要求开发了引导条件：一类是共享要求，其满足与否取决于多个智能体的共同作用；另一类是与每个智能体相关联并依赖于其邻居的私有要求。
tldr: 提出DeGG-Flow框架，通过将生成过程建模为控制仿射动力系统，为多智能体流匹配实现共享要求与私有要求的解耦生成引导，使各智能体无需依赖其他智能体的引导输入即可满足硬性约束。
en_tdlr: DeGG-Flow is proposed as a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance, which models the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, enabling agents to satisfy both shared and private hard constraints without relying on other agents' guidance inputs.
